PRO.claim_triples.statement:
PRO.claim_triples : PRO.Claim →
  ∃ V',
    (∀ t ∈ V', t ∈ PRO.V) ∧
      V'.card = 1000 ∧
        ∀ a ∈ V',
          ∀ b ∈ V',
            ∀ c ∈ V',
              a ≠ b →
                a ≠ c →
                  b ≠ c →
                    ∀ t < 50304,
                      t ≠ c →
                        PRO.logit PRO.pythia14m [0, a, b, c, a, b] t < PRO.logit PRO.pythia14m [0, a, b, c, a, b] c
'PRO.claim_triples'

PRO.opp_inductionOn_iff.statement:
PRO.opp_inductionOn_iff : ∀ (V' : Finset ℕ) (δ : ℝ),
  PRO.Opp.InductionOn PRO.pythia14m V' δ ↔
    ∀ (r : List ℕ),
      PRO.Admissible V' r → ∀ (k : ℕ), 2 ≤ k → k + 1 ≤ r.length → ∀ t < 50304, t ≠ r.getD k 0 → δ ≤ PRO.gap r k t
'PRO.opp_inductionOn_iff'

PRO.opp_failsOn_iff.statement:
PRO.opp_failsOn_iff : ∀ (S : Finset ℕ),
  PRO.Opp.FailsOn PRO.pythia14m S ↔
    ∃ r,
      PRO.Admissible S r ∧
        ∃ k,
          2 ≤ k ∧
            k + 1 ≤ r.length ∧
              ∃ t < 50304,
                t ≠ r.getD k 0 ∧
                  PRO.logit PRO.pythia14m (0 :: (r ++ List.take k r)) (r.getD k 0) ≤
                    PRO.logit PRO.pythia14m (0 :: (r ++ List.take k r)) t
'PRO.opp_failsOn_iff'
